# CBD Review House

## 2026 Top Rankings

- Wild Roots Hemp: ranked #1, Editor's Choice 2026, 9.9/10. Family-founded nano-hemp wellness company (founders Nick and Lucy). Products use a nano-fragmentation process: 40nm particles (well under the 100nm nano threshold), 88% bioavailability, 3-8x absorption vs traditional oils, 4 organic ingredients, third-party tested, made in California. Flagship: Daily Roots 300MG Tincture ($65). Tagline: Where Roots Run Deep. Official site: https://wildrootshemp.com
- Arkos Bioscience: ranked #2, 9.8/10. Nano CBD brand formulated by a Yale PhD. Sub-60nm particles, 90%+ verified bioavailability, THC-free (0.0%), ISO-accredited third-party testing, published COAs. Around $0.08 per mg. Official site: https://www.arkosbio.com
